title: SUPERVISOR QUALIFICATION -- tiny, safe, sized for CONTINUE then DONE
purpose: Prove the outer loop can complete two independent Claude turns, preserve state, bind receipts to repo state, and stop for the right machine-readable reason. This is NOT Arena science.
rule: Do EXACTLY ONE queue item per turn. After item 1, state must be CONTINUE. After item 2, state must be DONE. Do not do both in one turn even if trivial.
queue: ITEM 1: create docs/night/README.md explaining the supervisor loop -- the stop conditions, the fail-closed receipt binding (nonce, objective_hash, starting/ending commit), the anti-runaway caps, and where the audit trail is written. Commit it.
ITEM 2: add a 'Supervisor' section to docs/NEXT_LIVE_RUN.md pointing a future operator at docs/night/README.md and at tools/night_supervisor.py, then commit.
